items.title: Formal smoothness restricts to open subschemes of source and base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)

items.difficulty_reason: If f : X -> S is formally smooth, then its restriction U -> V to open subschemes with f(U) contained in V is formally smooth. The proof runs the lifting definition directly: given a solid diagram with a first-order thickening, formal smoothness of f produces an S-morphism T' -> X extending the given map; since T and T' have the same underlying topological space, the lift factors through the open U, and it is a V-morphism because the diagram commutes. Retained author proof at lines 3147-3161.
